title: An element annihilating the first module acts trivially on Ext
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $N$ and $M$ be $R$-modules, and $r\in R$ annihilate $N$ (that is, $rn=0$ for every $n\in N$). Then, for every integer $i\ge0$, the endomorphism of $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(N,M)$ [def-pc-ext] induced by the map $M\xrightarrow{r}M$ is zero.
